charter.changed: The charter has changed: read it and accept it again to continue.
charter.free: Mutual help is free and voluntary: I neither ask for nor give money, gifts or services in return.
charter.limits: Mutual help does not replace a professional (social worker, doctor, lawyer) and promises no aid or decision.
charter.moderation: I report any worrying behaviour; the moderation team can suspend a pseudonym.
charter.privacy: I do not ask for or share information about health, disability, administrative situation or private life; I keep no papers or codes belonging to another person.
charter.public: The first meeting takes place in a public place; I do not enter the home of a person I do not know.
charter.respect: I stay respectful; anyone can stop at any time. I do not look after children and do not accompany a minor alone.

safety.money: Never give money, gifts, bank details, identity papers, codes or passwords. Mutual help is free.
safety.n114: emergency by text message (for people who are deaf, hard of hearing or unable to speak)
safety.n119: Allô Enfance en Danger (child protection helpline), if a child is in danger

safety.private: Do not talk about your health, a disability or your administrative situation: it is not needed for a helping hand.
safety.public: For a first meeting, choose a public place (library, café, town hall lobby) — never your home.
safety.stop: You can stop at any time without giving a reason, and report or block a person.
